description: Audits code for logical errors before they become bugs — control flow gaps, data contract violations, schema/type drift, business logic inconsistencies, and silent failure paths. Produces a severity-rated issue list with a one-line diagnosis and one-line fix per finding. Use this skill whenever code is pasted with a review request, or when the user says "audit this", "check the logic", "does this make sense", "any issues with this", "logic audit", "what's wrong here", "review this function", "is this correct", or hands you any code file and wants a critical eye. Even if the user does not say "logic" — if code is present and they want feedback, use this skill. Also triggers on: "find the bug", "something feels off", "is this right", "sanity check this", "does this hold", "validate my logic", "code review", "PR review", "review this PR".
